live.title: Live View
live.subtitle: Cameras stream through the ERP. The recorder is never reachable from the browser.
live.noChannels: No camera channels have been imported yet. Add a recorder and run a probe to discover its channels.
live.loadError: Could not load cameras. Check that the recorder is reachable from the server.
live.capacity: This host can carry {{count}} simultaneous streams
live.hardwareOff: Software encoding — capacity is severely limited
live.cappedNotice: A {{requested}}-camera layout was requested, but this host can only serve {{allowed}} at once. Showing {{allowed}}.
live.errorNoGateway: No media gateway is configured for this deployment.
live.errorTicket: The stream authorisation expired. Retry to get a new one.
live.errorCapacity: This host has no capacity for another stream right now.
live.errorRateLimited: Too many stream requests. Wait a moment and retry.
live.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to view this camera.

devices.title: Recorders
devices.subtitle: Every recorder this tenant can reach, and what it reports about itself.
devices.empty: No recorders have been added yet.

dashboard.title: Surveillance Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Live state of every recorder, camera and transcode. Blank means unknown, never zero.
dashboard.mediaUnreachable: Media host unreachable — Live will not work
dashboard.clockWarningBody: NTP is disabled on {{devices}}. Playback times are taken from the recorder's own clock and may not match real time.

unsupportedOnDevice: This recorder does not support it.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Every camera channel, as the recorder reports it. Names are ERP aliases and are never written to the device.
channels.empty: No channels have been imported. Run a probe on a recorder to discover them.

storage.title: Storage
storage.subtitle: Recorder disks and partitions, summed across every partition rather than read from the first.
storage.unreadable: This recorder did not answer. Its storage state is unknown.
storage.readOnlyNotice: This page is read-only. Formatting or clearing a surveillance disk destroys evidence, so no destructive storage action is available.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Who changed what, on which recorder, and whether it worked. Secrets are never recorded.
audit.loadError: Could not load the audit log.
audit.empty: No surveillance activity has been recorded yet.

capability.unsupported: This recorder does not support it.
capability.readOnly: This recorder reports it but will not let it be changed.
capability.unknown: The probe could not determine whether this recorder supports it.

deviceDetail.title: Recorder
deviceDetail.subtitle: Everything this recorder reports about itself. Serial numbers and cloud identifiers are deliberately not shown.
deviceDetail.capabilitiesNote: Taken from the probe. Anything not confirmed as supported hides its control rather than disabling it.
deviceDetail.unknownCount: {{count}} capability could not be determined, so its controls stay hidden.
deviceDetail.streamProfilesNote: The encoder slots this recorder actually exposes, as discovered by the probe.
deviceDetail.ntpWarning: NTP is disabled on this recorder, so its clock will drift. Recording timestamps and playback windows are only as accurate as this clock. Enabling NTP is a separate approved change and is not performed here.

video.title: Video Settings
video.subtitle: Encoder configuration per channel, as the recorder reports it.
video.loadError: Could not read the encoder configuration.
video.mainStreamNote: The recording and full-quality live stream.
video.subStreamNote: Hardware-limited on this recorder to CIF at 7fps — it is not a quality option.
video.writeGateNotice: Read-only. Changing encoder settings across channels is a mass configuration change and needs separate approval, so the write workflow below is shown but not armed.
video.writeWorkflowNote: Every step already exists server-side. It is listed so an approved change holds no surprises.
video.channel1Note: Channel 1 is at the approved 2048 kbps. Channels 2–16 remain at 512 kbps and are not changed by this build.

step.owner: Require the owner guard where the capability is dangerous
step.allowlist: Refuse any parameter outside the typed allowlist
step.snapshot: Read and store the current value first
step.diff: Show a semantic before/after diff for approval
step.verify: Read the value back and compare
step.audit: Write an audit record with old and new values
step.rollback: Restore the snapshot if verification fails

recording.title: Recording Settings
recording.subtitle: Recording mode and schedule per channel, read from the recorder.
recording.loadError: Could not read the recording configuration.
recording.readOnlyNotice: Read-only. A recording schedule decides what footage exists tomorrow, so no change is made from here.
recording.scheduleNote: The recorder returns eight rows for a seven-day week: row 0 is an all-days template, not Sunday.
recording.triggersNote: What causes this channel to record.

motion.title: Motion Settings
motion.subtitle: Motion detection per channel, with the sensitivity scale this recorder actually uses.
motion.loadError: Could not read the motion configuration.
motion.readOnlyNotice: Read-only. Motion settings decide what a motion-triggered channel records, so no change is made from here.
motion.sensitivityNote: The scale is read from the device. This recorder uses 0–100, not the 1–6 most documentation describes.
motion.actionsNote: What the recorder does when motion is detected.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Recorder network configuration, read-only.
network.unreadable: This recorder did not answer. Its network configuration is unknown.
network.writeGateNotice: Read-only. A wrong network change makes the recorder unreachable by the system making the change, with no second attempt — so writes stay disabled pending separate approval.

snapshot.title: Snapshot — {{channel}}
snapshot.notStoredNote: This image is not stored. Saving records who took it and when, not the image itself.
snapshot.forbidden: You do not have permission to capture from this camera.
snapshot.rateLimited: Too many captures. Wait a moment.

playback.title: Playback
playback.subtitle: Recorded footage, streamed in bounded windows. Nothing is downloaded.
playback.searchFailed: The recorder could not be searched.
playback.pickSegment: Choose a segment from the timeline.
playback.clockWarning: DVR NTP is disabled — recording timestamps may drift. Times below come from the recorder's own clock and may not match real time.

onvifState.needs-account: ONVIF refused the ERP credentials — it likely needs its own ONVIF account, which requires approval.
onvifState.not-supported: This firmware does not implement ONVIF Profile G.
onvifState.unreachable: The ONVIF endpoint did not respond.
